urls.title: PDF URLs
urls.description: Direct links to PDF files (reports, papers, invoices, manuals, forms). Files in your Apify key-value stores work too: use the record URL (https://api.apify.com/v2/key-value-stores/STORE_ID/records/KEY). Up to 10,000 per run.

textFormat.title: Text format
textFormat.description: Plain text keeps the line breaks of the PDF. Markdown also turns large-font lines into # headings and marks each page with <!-- page N -->, which works well for LLMs and RAG chunking.

includePages.title: Text per page
includePages.description: Add a 'pages' list with the text and word count of every page, for citations and page-level search.

pageRange.title: Pages to read
pageRange.description: Only read these pages, like 1-5, 8, 10- (from page 10 to the end) or -3 (the first three). Leave empty for every page.

maxChars.title: Maximum text length (characters)
maxChars.description: Cut the text at a word boundary after this many characters (textTruncated tells you when it happened). 0 keeps the full text.

includeLinks.title: Links in the PDF
includeLinks.description: Add the web links (clickable link annotations) found in the PDF.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages per PDF
maxPages.description: Stop reading a PDF after this many pages (counted after the page range).

maxFileSizeMb.title: Maximum file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped and not charged. Raise the run memory to 2 GB or more for files over 100 MB.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel downloads
maxConcurrency.description: How many PDFs to download and read at the same time (at most 2 at once per website).
